verification_candidates.rationale: Contested mortality-ranking claim about medical error.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Heart disease and cancer are completely preventable through lifestyle changes.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: The first two are completely preventable through lifestyle changes
verification_candidates.rationale: Absolute prevention claim about the two leading causes of death.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The US health system invests in treating disease rather than lifestyle prevention because there is no money in keeping people healthy.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Why don't we treat it through lifestyle methods and put money into root cause? Because there's no money in that
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim about the profit motive behind health-system priorities.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Pharmaceutical companies train doctors, nurses, nurse practitioners and allied health professionals and design their curriculum.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: who trains our our providers? The pharmaceutical companies
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim about industry control of medical education.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Fifty to ninety percent of published medical research is funded by the pharmaceutical industry in some way.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: fifty to ninety percent of research coming out is funded by pharma in one way, shape, or form
verification_candidates.rationale: Specific research-funding statistic that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Pharmaceutical companies control the narrative and agenda of medicine and aim to create customers rather than health.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: They're not about. Creating health, they're about creating customers
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim about deliberate industry conduct shaping medicine.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Patients are kept sick and moved from one medication to another until they are never able to get off medication.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Before you know it, you're never able to get off any sort of medication
verification_candidates.rationale: Generalised claim about medication cascades.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The Women's Health Initiative study's conclusions about hormone therapy were unjustified and incorrect and have since been retracted.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: So we come out with unjustified, incorrect conclusions, which have since been retracted, but decades later, and the damage is done
verification_candidates.rationale: Checkable claim about the status of the WHI findings.

certainty_markers: the one thing that truly helps women
verification_candidates.claim_text: Hormone replacement is the one thing that truly helps women, and the many treatments that replaced it do not help women at all.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: get rid of the one thing that truly helps women, and replace it with nine, ten, eleven, twelve things that don't help women at all
verification_candidates.rationale: Strong comparative efficacy claim about HRT versus alternatives.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Hormone replacement therapy causes breast cancer.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: And we tell women that hormone replacement causes breast cancer
verification_candidates.rationale: Rebutted causal claim about HRT and breast cancer.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Hormone replacement therapy is not neuroprotective and does not help with dementia.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: We tell them that it's not neuroprotective; it doesn't help with dementia
verification_candidates.rationale: Rebutted claim about HRT and dementia prevention.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Hormone replacement therapy is not osteoprotective and does not help bone health.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: We tell them it's not osteoprotective; it doesn't help with with bone health
verification_candidates.rationale: Rebutted claim about HRT and bone protection.
